new_promises.statement: Maintain EBITDA margin at 26% to 27% on average for the full financial year.
new_promises.quote: on average for the full financial year, it will be maintained at 26% to 27% as we have been maintaining in the past.
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Expect repair and overhaul (ROH) revenue growth to be 10% to 12% on a year-to-year basis.
new_promises.quote: ROH as a growth perspective, it will be 10% to 12%.
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Maintain cash balance around Rs. 15,000 crore as of 31st March 2023.
new_promises.quote: on average, we should be able to maintain Rs. 15,000 for 31st March 2023.
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan

new_promises.statement: Deliver 83 Mark1A LCA program with 3 numbers in the first scheduled year.
new_promises.quote: Once we start delivering 83 LCAs, to start with we will do 3 numbers and subsequently as per the delivery schedule
new_promises.speaker: C.B. Ananthakrishnan
